$schema_comment: Project receiving wallets for protocol fees + donations across chain families. Single source of truth — Deploy.s.sol reads `evm.address`, the Solana program reads `solana.address`, and the BTC entry is currently documentation-only (BitcoinBridge.sol has no protocol-level fee — LPs collect their own fees via HTLC). If any address rotates, update here AND the corresponding constant in script/Deploy.s.sol or the corresponding init param when re-deploying the Solana program.

evm.purpose: Owner + fee recipient on every deployed Mixer / ERC20Mixer / ShieldedPool / YieldPool / CrossChainBridge. After Deploy.s.sol runs, this address must broadcast `acceptOwnership()` on each pool to finalise the 2-step transfer.

solana.purpose: MixerPool.fee_recipient — receives the 1% protocol fee on every Solana withdrawal. Initialised on `initialize_pool`; rotateable by authority via `set_fee_recipient`. Authority and fee_recipient are decoupled so the admin key (authority) can rotate without changing where fees flow.
solana.constant_in_code: Passed as `fee_recipient` arg to initialize_pool — see solana/programs/privacy_mixer/src/lib.rs

bitcoin.purpose: Project BTC receiving address. Currently documentation-only: BitcoinBridge.sol uses an LP-fee model (each LP sets their own feeBps), so there is no protocol-level BTC fee on-chain. This address is intended for: BTC-side fees once a protocol fee path is added to the HTLC flow, operator's BTC earnings from running the bridge LP, or donations to the project. Not used by any code yet — surface as a config in the frontend's support / donations section if needed.
